nodes.label: Group Code Icon
nodes.description: An SVG icon depicting three overlapping user/person silhouettes arranged in a group formation. The center figure sits slightly elevated and overlaps the two flanking figures. Each silhouette consists of a circular head and a rounded-bottom torso/body shape, all rendered in white fill with black strokes. The composition conveys a concept of a group, team, or community. Additionally, three small clusters of dots (each cluster containing 4 dots arranged in an L or square pattern) appear at three corners of the composition — upper-right, lower-left, and upper-left near the center figure. These dot clusters suggest a 'code' or 'keypad' metaphor, reinforcing the 'group code' naming. The overall icon is likely used to represent a group invitation code, referral group, team code, or community access feature.

properties.description: SVG icon depicting a single person/user avatar with a circular head and body silhouette, rendered in black and white (black fill on white). Accompanied by a cluster of small decorative dots arranged in an L-shaped or corner pattern at top-right and bottom-right, likely representing a 'code' or 'individual contributor' concept. The icon is 24x26px and uses simple geometric shapes.
properties.design_intent: Represents a single individual or user, likely used in contexts related to individual code contributions, personal profiles, or single-user selection in an app interface.

properties.description: Two SVG paths forming a head (circle) and body (rounded rectangle/silhouette) of a person avatar, filled white with black stroke.
Multiple small black filled dot/pill shapes arranged in two clusters, one at top-right and one at bottom-right of the icon, visually suggesting code lines or a code badge motif.

nodes.label: AI Loader Animation
nodes.description: Animated GIF used as an AI processing loader. Depicts a central 'AI' node (purple rounded rectangle) connected via golden circuit-like lines to four surrounding icons: a text icon (green square with 'T'), a video/play icon (pink circle with play triangle), a microphone/audio icon (teal microphone), and an image icon (navy rectangle with mountain/landscape). Represents AI processing multiple content modalities (text, video, audio, image). Used as a loading indicator in AI-related UI contexts.

nodes.label: Danger Warning Animation
nodes.description: Animated GIF depicting a warning/danger icon: a rounded triangle with a dark navy blue outer border, a thick orange/amber inner border, a white fill, and an orange exclamation mark (! symbol) in the center. A light blue reflective sheen is visible on the lower-left of the triangle interior. Used as a visual alert or danger indicator in the UI, likely shown in warning dialogs, error states, or cautionary modals.

nodes.label: Building Icon
nodes.description: A 24x24 SVG icon depicting a multi-story office building or institutional structure. The icon shows a rectangular building outline with a flat roofline, multiple evenly-spaced rectangular windows arranged in a grid pattern on the facade, and a centered doorway at the base. The design uses a single white filled path on a transparent background, giving it a clean, flat icon style suitable for navigation menus, content management interfaces, or facility/organization-related UI contexts. It communicates concepts of buildings, offices, organizations, or physical locations.

nodes.label: Price Tag Alt Icon
nodes.description: A 24x24 SVG icon depicting a price tag / label shape. The design shows a tag outline with a small circular hole (representing a tag eyelet) in the upper-left area and a pointed or angled right edge, rendered as a white filled path on a transparent background. The icon communicates pricing, tagging, labeling, or content categorization concepts and is used in the content management section of the UI.

nodes.label: User Icon SVG
nodes.description: A 24x24 white-filled SVG icon depicting a generic user/person. Features a circular head shape at the top and a curved body/shoulder silhouette at the bottom, representing a human figure. Designed as a single-path icon on a transparent background with white fill, suitable for use on dark or colored backgrounds. Commonly used in content management interfaces to represent a user profile, author attribution, or account identity.

nodes.label: Credentials Page Side Illustration
nodes.description: SVG sidebar illustration for the credentials/authentication page. Features a warm peach/salmon background (#FCE8E2) with decorative brand-colored elements: a large arc/circle shape with gradient fill, a star/flame shape with gradient, a solid circle in a lighter pink tone, repeating rows of upward and downward pointing triangles in brand orange (#EE4723) at low opacity, wavy sinusoidal lines in brand orange at low opacity in the upper-right corner, and repeating chevron/arrow patterns in brand orange at low opacity in the upper-left corner. The overall aesthetic is abstract and decorative, conveying motion and energy through geometric patterns. Dimensions: 756x982px.
